summary: Short access check on the real account rgonzalez@megasoft.com.ve after the unlock and password reset. Only 2 logins were made, both with the correct password (1 API, 1 UI). No negative tests were run. Before logging in, the password was checked offline with config.verify_password: it matches MegaSoft2026*. Expiry: not expired. 2FA: off. Then POST /api/auth/login returned 200 'Login exitoso' with a session_token, role=admin and password_expires_in_days=null. The UI login at /login landed on /dashboard. /integrators loaded and showed data-testid=company-directory (380 companies). The DB after the logins shows account_status=ACTIVE, failed_login_attempts=0, no lockout_timestamp and must_change_password=False.

issues: At 1920px the title 'Gestión de Integradores' wraps onto 2 lines. The row of 9 action buttons runs past the right edge of the content container: 'Nuevo Proyecto de Integración' ends beyond the directory card.

action_items: None blocking. Optional: wrap or condense the /integrators header action buttons.
critical_code_review_comments: login: reset_failures() runs after the password is verified but before the is_active check. A deactivated user with the correct password gets their counters reset and then a 403. Harmless, but the order could be is_active check first.
check_lock only auto-unlocks when the lockout duration has passed. An admin unlock goes through POST /api/admin/users/{id}/unlock, which is correct.
seed_data_creation: None. No data was created or modified apart from the 2 sessions created by the logins.
context_for_next_testing_agent: rgonzalez is the user's real account: never try wrong passwords with it (5 failures = 15 min lockout). For regression runs use check_rgonzalez_state.py, which is read-only and verifies the password offline without spending login attempts. Server clock is Nov 2026; password_changed_at=2026-11-22, max age 90 days.
rca of the issue: The account was LOCKED with failed_login_attempts=5 and the stored hash did not match MegaSoft2026*. The main agent set account_status=ACTIVE, failed_login_attempts=0, removed lockout_timestamp and set a new hash with must_change_password=False. Verified fixed.
